cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.
items.quote: Financial advisors are generally compensated on a commission basis, subject to a minimum guaranteed salary, and may be entitled to additional compensation based on their respective branch office profitability and the profitability of the Partnership.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that most financial advisors receive a portion of the Program Fee, while some financial advisors receive a salary in addition to, or in lieu of, the Program Fee.
items.quote: Most financial advisors receive a portion of the Program Fee, though some financial advisors receive a salary in addition to, or in lieu of, the Program Fee.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that the portion of the Program Fee paid to a financial advisor is at Edward Jones' discretion, and the fee rate paid to the advisor is the same regardless of the model or investment advisory program in which the client invests.
items.quote: The portion of the Program Fee paid to your financial advisor is at the discretion of Edward Jones. The fee rate paid to your financial advisor will be the same regardless of the model in which you invest.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that the Program Fee, assets under care, and Reserve Line Advance balances will impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and the bonus amount.
items.quote: The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and Reserve Line Advance balances, will impact most financial advisors' eligibility for a bonus and bonus amount.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that the Program Fee, assets under care, and client Reserve Line Advance balances may impact a financial advisor's eligibility to receive certain limited partnership profits interest in The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P.
items.quote: The Program Fee, as well as assets under care and client Reserve Line Advance balances may also impact a financial advisors' eligibility for the receipt of certain limited partnership profits interest in The Jones Financial Companies, L.L.L.P. (the "Profits Interest").

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that most financial advisors are eligible for the Edward Jones Travel Award Program, with eligibility based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care of the financial advisor.
items.quote: Most financial advisors are eligible to participate in the Edward Jones Travel Award Program... Eligibility for the Travel Award Program is based upon the amount of new and existing assets under care of a financial advisor.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors.
items.quote: Financial advisor bonuses are determined by the overall Partnership's profitability, as well as the performance of the individual financial advisors.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that a portion of sales charges or commissions paid in brokerage is paid to the financial advisor, and that an advisor typically earns more in upfront fees and commissions with brokerage services but more over time in Advisory Solutions Fund Models.
items.quote: you would pay sales charges or commissions, a portion of which would be paid to your financial advisor. A financial advisor will typically earn more in upfront fees and commissions when you use brokerage services. In the alternative, a financial advisor will typically earn more over time if you invest in Advisory Solutions Fund Models.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that a financial advisor may receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of the financial advisor's branch.
items.quote: your financial advisor may also receive compensation in connection with Reserve Line Advances depending on the profitability of your financial advisor's branch.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that it maintains a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.
items.quote: The Partnership has a non-qualified deferred compensation plan for certain financial advisors.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that eligible retiring financial advisors are offered individually tailored retirement transition plans that compensate a retiring financial advisor for providing client transition services.
items.quote: Eligible retiring financial advisors are offered individually tailored retirement transition plans. Each retirement transition plan compensates a retiring financial advisor for successfully providing client transition services in accordance with a retirement and transition agreement.

items.text: Edward Jones discloses that a significant portion of its more successful financial advisors' compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability, and that bonuses and profit-sharing contributions paid to financial advisors may be decreased or eliminated if profitability decreases.
items.quote: there is increased risk the Partnership's more successful financial advisors may leave because a significant portion of their compensation is variable based on the Partnership's profitability.

cells.reason: The passages contain multiple direct statements describing how Edward Jones structures financial advisor compensation (commission basis, minimum salary, branch and Partnership profitability bonuses, Program Fee portion, profits interest, travel awards, deferred compensation, and retirement transition plans).
